_description: Export this file from the tracker UI using 'Export JSON'. After saving it here, tracker/data/progress.json is the repo-visible source of truth for progress and startDate. Browser localStorage is only a convenience cache.
_workflow: 3. Log your daily progress (status, hours, DSA, notes)
9. Commit tracker/data/*.json plus generated markdown, then push

days._comment: Keys are day numbers (1-180). Values are per-day progress records.

courses._comment: Keys are course IDs from courses.json. Values: todo|in-progress|done

patterns._comment: Keys are pattern IDs from leetcode.json. Values: 0-4 (mastery level)

portfolio._comment: Keys are artifact IDs from artifacts.json proofChecklist. Values: true|false

miniProjects._comment: Keys are mini-project IDs from artifacts.json (week-01 through week-18). Values: true|false

aiArtifacts._comment: Keys are AI artifact IDs from ai-engineering.json (week-01 through week-18). Values: true|false

aiReadiness._comment: Keys are readiness dimension IDs from readiness.json. Values: 0-5 (score)

systemDesign._comment: Keys are topic IDs from system-design.json. Values: not-started|studied|drilled|mock-ready
